create.name: Paul Levy
create.bio:
Paul Levy is a Portland-based writer and teacher whose central theme is the dreamlike nature of reality. His path began in 1981 with an overwhelming spiritual awakening that the medical system of the day did not know how to read; he came to understand it instead as a shamanic initiation, and found teachers who supported him through it. Out of that experience he founded the Awaken in the Dream community in Portland more than thirty years ago, and he is often cited as an early voice on spiritual emergence.

His teaching draws together Tibetan Buddhism, the depth psychology of C. G. Jung, alchemy, shamanism, Kabbalah, mystical Christianity and the strange findings of quantum physics. He is best known for his books on wetiko, a Native American term he uses for a contagious blindness in the human psyche that drives selfishness and destruction, and which he believes also carries the seeds of its own undoing once it is seen clearly. Other books include The Quantum Revelation and Awakened by Darkness. He offers private one-to-one sessions and a regular group session for people whose sense of reality is opening up, and he writes regularly for his readers online.

books.title: The Quantum Revelation: Awakening to the Dreamlike Nature of Reality
books.author: Paul Levy
books.description: An expanded edition of his book linking quantum physics with the spiritual insight that the world is dreamlike. He argues that the physics points towards a participatory universe that our awareness helps to shape.

books.title: Undreaming Wetiko: Breaking the Spell of the Nightmare Mind-Virus
books.author: Paul Levy
books.description: Continues his exploration of wetiko, the self-deceiving blindness he sees at work in individuals and societies. The book looks at how recognising it can turn it into a doorway to awakening.

books.title: Dispelling Wetiko: Breaking the Curse of Evil
books.author: Paul Levy
books.description: His first full study of wetiko, drawing on Jung, Buddhism and Native American thought. It sets out how a collective shadow spreads unseen and how inner work can loosen its hold.

courses.title: 50-Minute Private Session
courses.description: A one-to-one conversation with Paul for people going through a spiritual opening and wanting a wider frame for it. Sessions are requested through his Work with Paul page.

courses.title: Awaken in the Dream Group Session
courses.description: A group meeting of the Awaken in the Dream community he started in Portland, paid on a small sliding scale. Participants explore the dreamlike nature of their own experience together.
